title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 057
review_goal: Differentiate emoji, eye, and factory variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Smiling face with two round eyes above one curved mouth
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple happy face with two open round eyes.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the winking face when one eye should close and the mouth should open.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a closed curved smile and two matching round eyes.

items.depicts_observation: Winking face with one vertical eye above an open mouth and one angled wink
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a playful wink with one open mouth instead of a closed smile.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simple smiling face when both eyes should stay round and open.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot swaps one eye into a wink and opens the mouth into a wide smile shape.

items.depicts_observation: Eye outline with one crescent moon pupil centered inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants an eye outline with a crescent center rather than a plain round pupil.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the round pupil eye when the center should look like a complete dot.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot places a crescent moon shape inside the eye instead of a full pupil.

items.depicts_observation: Eye outline with one round pupil centered around one inner dot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a standard eye outline with a round pupil in the middle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the crescent eye when the center should suggest a moon shaped pupil.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses a full circular pupil with a small center dot instead of a crescent.

items.depicts_observation: Factory silhouette with two cooling towers above a flat ground line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants two tall cooling tower shapes instead of a boxy factory building.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the zigzag roof factory when windows and one chimney should show.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is mostly two tapered cooling towers rising from one flat base line.
